hints.text: 'Centre of', 'in', and 'bad' are our indicators — one is a selector, telling us which letter(s) to use, another is a container, instructing us to put something inside something else, and a third is an anagram indicator, flagging that the order of some letters needs to change.
Our fodder is 'net' and 'minton'. We'll need to use these letters (or some of them) as directed by the indicator(s) to construct our answer.
The definition is 'Raise' — and our answer will have a meaning that overlaps with the idea of 'raising'.
